name: app-dark-information-architecture-pill-tree-with-blue-highlights
title: Dark Information Architecture Pill Tree
whatItIs: A dark slate slide titled Information Architecture with a plane progress bar, a paragraph and a large dense tree of pill nodes from a logo root through Home, Flight, Hotel and My Booking to detailed steps in columns, with blue gradient pills marking key screens.
whatItMeans: Dark nodes with a few glowing blue ones make a large structure legible, and the dense grid shows thoroughness.
techniques: Blue gradient pills marking key screens
Dark grey pills with subtle borders for the rest
Columns aligned in a grid for a clean tree
Logo in a circle as the root
Diagram cropped at the right and bottom

vocabulary.definition: The organisation and labelling of a product's content.
A highlighted node marking an important screen.
A hierarchical diagram of all screens.
